findings.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
findings.rationale: The cap is one-sided: TrueLink's liability is capped at 12 months' fees while our liability (including under the broad Client indemnity in Section 12(a)) is unlimited, and there are no carve-outs for confidentiality, data or IP infringement. Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000 with standard uncapped Excluded Claims.

replacement.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
replacement.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTH PERIOD AND (B) USD 1,000,000, AND NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES IS NOT SUBJECT TO THIS CAP.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We made the cap mutual (greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1M) rather than a Vendor-only shield, since our indemnity exposure is currently unlimited, and added the standard Excluded Claims that sit outside the cap (confidentiality/data, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement).

findings.quote: TrueLink shall indemnify and hold Client harmless, its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, agents and licensors harmless from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses, and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to any
findings.rationale: TrueLink's indemnity covers only its breach or non-performance and does not cover third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Interface, breach of law, or a data breach caused by TrueLink — while our indemnity in Section 12(a) is very broad. We need an express IP indemnity for the licensed Interface.

replacement.oldText: claim arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder.
replacement.newText: (i) any claim arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder; (ii) any allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any deliverable infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (iii) TrueLink's breach of applicable law; (iv) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content, Credit Data or other Client data caused by TrueLink; or (v) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] As licensee of the Interface we require an express third-party IP infringement indemnity from TrueLink, plus indemnities for breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct. We are also happy to discuss narrowing the very broad Client indemnity in Section 12(a) in exchange.

findings.quote: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
findings.rationale: We would be granting TrueLink the right to distribute, license, resell and exploit our borrower Credit Data, subject only to an unattached Non-Competition Agreement. We do not license out our data for the Vendor's own commercial exploitation; the licence must be limited to providing the services to us, with our ownership expressly retained.

replacement.comment: [Playbook] We retain ownership of our data and cannot grant resale/exploitation rights over borrower Credit Data; the licence is narrowed to what TrueLink needs to deliver the services. We have also confirmed our ownership of the results of the Support Services.

findings.quote: TrueLink shall perform the Hosting and Support Services and any other agreed-upon services for Client with the same degree of care, skill and prudence customarily exercised by it for its own operations.
findings.rationale: The only express warranty is a Y2K warranty, and Section 12 disclaims all other warranties; the "same care as for its own operations" standard is self-referential and gives us no conformance warranty or remedy. We need a professional-services warranty with a 90-day conformance period and a repair/re-perform/refund remedy carved out of the disclaimer.

replacement.newText: TrueLink shall perform the Hosting and Support Services and any other agreed-upon services for Client in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards, and warrants that for a period of ninety (90) days following performance such services and any deliverable will conform in all material respects to their documentation and to this Agreement, and that the Interface will be free of viruses, worms and other malicious code. Client's remedy for breach of this warranty is re-performance, repair or replacement or, if TrueLink cannot cure, a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services or deliverable. This express warranty is not subject to the disclaimer set forth in Section 12.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] We replaced the self-referential standard of care with a professional/workmanlike warranty and a 90-day conformance warranty with a real remedy, and carved it out of the Section 12 disclaimer so the disclaimer does not swallow it.

31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, because TrueLink processes Client data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. TrueLink shall provide certificates of insurance on request.
replacement.comment: [Playbook] Standard insurance package for a vendor hosting our site and processing consumer credit data. Fallback: E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.

findings.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
findings.rationale: The 30-day non-renewal window and 12-month renewal terms are acceptable, but the price protection in Section 6 lasts only one year, so renewal pricing is uncapped. We also note the cross-reference to "Section 12" (Indemnity) should be Section 14 (Termination).

replacement.oldText: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
replacement.newText: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 14 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year. TrueLink shall notify Client at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of each term of the upcoming renewal, and any increase in fees for a renewal term shall not exceed the lesser of the increase in CPI and three percent (3%).
replacement.comment: [Playbook] The notice window is fine; we added a renewal reminder and capped renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3% (fallback 5%), since the Section 6 price freeze expires after year one. We also corrected the cross-reference to the Termination section.

findings.quote: Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
findings.rationale: Section 14 appears to give Client a convenience termination right effective at the end of the following month with no penalty, which meets our position, but it is not expressed as a right to terminate and the cross-references (Section 13 pointing to "Section 12") are inconsistent. We should confirm the mechanic and add a pro-rata refund of any prepaid fees; note Sections 2 and 3 can also terminate immediately on certain Client-side events.

findings.quote: subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement
findings.rationale: Section 2(a) helpfully confirms we may build or buy competing software, but Section 8(d) incorporates an unattached "Non-Competition Agreement" whose restrictions we cannot assess. We should review that document and confirm it imposes no field-of-use or competitive restriction on Client.

findings.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
findings.rationale: The MFN runs in our favour (TrueLink's Hosting Services rates cannot exceed those charged to any other party), which we welcome; no redline needed.

findings.quote: This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law).
findings.rationale: California law with exclusive jurisdiction of California state/federal courts falls within our accepted list, and there is no arbitration. We note venue is TrueLink's home county (San Luis Obispo) — acceptable but we may request a neutral California venue.

findings.quote: Client will be provided upon request with documentation supporting the amount charged
findings.rationale: The Agreement contains no audit or inspection right against Client; the only verification right runs in our favour. No change required.

findings.quote: TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
findings.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties or early-termination fees are payable by Client (the monthly minimums are addressed separately under the minimum-commitment finding).
The Agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire restriction binding Client, which matches our preferred position.
